name: use-loaded-deslop-method
reason: Preserve the pre-commit review without routing through a Cursor plugin command.
anchor: Work from a git worktree off trunk, and keep unrelated work out of it. Rebase into small, landable commits. Run `/deslop` from `cursor-team-kit` over the diff before commit.
find: Run `/deslop` from `cursor-team-kit` over the diff before commit.
replace: If the suite includes the deslop skill, read it and apply it to the diff before commit; if absent, report the missing review method.

name: respect-review-only-methods
reason: Keep read-only investigation and local prototypes independent of delivery side effects.
anchor: Invoked at the end of every other playbook.
replace: Use at the end of a delivery playbook that calls for publishing a PR, or early when the selected autopilot playbook says so. Opening a PR is not a merge or deploy grant. Follow the task scope and existing project and forge requirements; read-only work does not publish.
